title: Catching Integer Division and Domain Bugs with Unit Tests
description: Examine a broken triangleArea(int base, int height) implementation to see why unit tests on different inputs expose integer-division and negative-input bugs.

steps.description: Look at triangleArea(int base, int height), which returns 1 / 2 * base * height on line 4.

steps.question: Why does 1 / 2 * base * height evaluate to 0 for every base and height?
steps.answer: Because 1 and 2 are both int literals, integer division evaluates 1 / 2 to 0 first, and 0 * base * height is always 0.

steps.description: Call triangleArea(5, 2) and triangleArea(3, -2) in main to see both print 0, and notice that height = -2 also tests an invalid negative dimension.
Step into triangleArea(5, 2) on line 4 to watch 1 / 2 * 5 * 2 return 0.
